name: Vaada sabse pehle
when: Har video ki shuruaat par
action: Title/thumbnail jo vaada kare, wahi cheez pehle seconds me dikhao ya bolo — result, sabse striking moment, ya woh sawal jiska jawab video hai
why: Viewer pehle seconds me faisla karta hai; YouTube ka official lever hai ki thumbnail/title asal content ko reflect kare aur intro wahi dikhaye
frequency: Har video; long-form me pehle 5-30 s ke window me, Shorts me pehle frame/3 s me
evidence_note: YouTube official guidance (YT-moments, platform) + Melvynx ke measured outlier data; ExpoCut playbook bhi yahi kehta hai

name: Intro, greeting, logo pehle nahi
when: Video ke opening seconds me
action: Logo intro, greeting ya 'in this video we'll see' se shuru mat karo; logo aaye to content ke upar card ki tarah aaye, alag shot me nahi
why: Pehle seconds vaade ke liye hain; intro pehle aane se audience wahi girti hai jahan video sabse kamzor hai
evidence_note: Creator practice (TubeBuddy/TikTok blogs) + kmilo aur Melvynx dono ke house rules; ExpoCut: 'never on an intro card'

name: Cold open = sabse mazboot moment
when: Video ki structure banate waqt
action: Video ke best moment/line ko shuruaat me rakho (vlog ka best pal, podcast ki sabse mazboot exchange, tutorial ka end-state), phir context par wapas aao
why: Thanda, dheere chadhne wala start viewer ko rok nahi pata; best moment hi thumbnail ke vaade ko sach karta hai
frequency: Talking head 5-15 s, podcast 15-60 s, tutorial hook 10-20 s (end-state pehle)
evidence_note: Creator practice (TubeBuddy-hacks aadi) — kmilo recipes ka standing structure rule

name: Hook formula se, score 7+ ka gate
when: Har script likhte waqt
action: 3 hooks 3 alag formulas se likho (22 formulas ki library: pain, claim, number, mistake, story, promise, curiosity, proof, reaction), har hook ko 5-point rubric (Specific, Tension, Viewer, Fast, True) par 0-2 score karo, best rakho; sab 7/10 se kam hon to 3 aur likho
why: Ek hi andaz ka hook aksar kamzor hota hai; teen vikalp + score se mazboot hook chunna aasan aur dohraane layak hota hai
frequency: Har script par 3 hooks; rakha hua hook ≥7/10
evidence_note: Melvynx studio-script ka creator system (rubric usi ka banaya hua, koi public data nahi)

name: On-screen hook chhota aur alag
when: Short ki pehli 1-2 s me on-screen text lagate waqt
action: Screen par hook 6-7 shabd se zyada nahi, ek accent word ke saath; woh spoken hook ki copy na ho, usme kuch jode (number, result, sawal)
why: Sound-off viewer ko screen wala hook hi rokta hai; bola hua dohraane se dusri jaankari ki jagah khali जाती hai
frequency: Har short; Melvynx ≤6 shabd, ExpoCut 4-7 shabd
evidence_note: Melvynx house rule + ExpoCut playbook practice (ExpoCut: Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Open loop kholo, aakhir se pehle band mat karo
when: Script ki structure me
action: Aage aane wali cheez announce karo ('teesri wali ne hairaan kar diya') aur uska payoff end ke paas do; har sentence usi ek vaade ko aage badhaye, detour nahi
why: Khula sawal viewer ko roke rakhta hai; jo hissa video ko aage nahi badhata, retention graph wahi girta hai
frequency: Har video me kam se kam 1 open loop, payoff end se pehle nahi
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo hook-and-retention); Melvynx ke measured viral data me 'one promise, paid line after line' isko support karta hai

name: Re-hook 40-60% par
when: Script ke beech wale hisse me
action: 40-60% ke aas-paas ek line rakho jo dhyaan restart kare: naya sawal, number, twist ('lekin isse theek nahi hua'), ya sabse mushkil hissa ('ye wala sab skip karte hain')
why: Beech me dhyaan girna sabse aam hai; ek naya gap wahi rokta hai jahan viewer jaane wala hota hai
frequency: 25 s se lambi har script me 1 re-hook; 25 s se chhoti skip kar sakte ho
evidence_note: Melvynx ke niche-outlier measurements (apne studied accounts) me consistent pattern — measured data, peer-reviewed nahi

name: Ek video = ek idea, ek vaada
when: Topic aur script tay karte waqt
action: Ek hi idea rakho; script me 'and also' aaye to woh dusri video hai; hook se ask tak ek hi promise chale
why: Do topics wala video dono me aadha rehta hai; ek vaada hi retention aur share dono banata hai
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules ka house rule

name: Topic pehle, script baad me (proven concept)
when: Kuch bhi likhne se pehle, planning par
action: Woh concept chuno jo niche me pehle over-perform kar chuka ho (account median ke x3+ outliers wala); kaam ka kram: topic > hook > structure; fresh news wala topic ho to use week me pehle rakho
why: Measured data kehta hai views topic se bante hain — same creator, same edit, topic badalte hi x1 se x100 ka farak
frequency: Week ke 5 scripts me kam se kam 3 proven concept par
evidence_note: Melvynx ke outlier measurements (har studied niche me median ke muqable) — measured data

name: Object 0 second par, hook me specific
when: Short ke pehle frame aur pehli line par
action: Jis cheez ke baare me video hai use pehle second me dikhao (naam baad me), aur pehli line me kam se kam ek specific rakho: number, bade brand ka naam, ya 'free'
why: Viewer 1 s me tay karta hai 'ye mere liye hai ya nahi'; creator ke baare me hook ya vague category x1 par reh jati hai
evidence_note: Melvynx viral research ke measured rules (every niche checked)

name: Proof 8 second ke andar
when: Video ki shuruaat me
action: 8 s ke andar proof dikha do — number, screen, ya receipt — taaki viewer ko baaki video par bharosa ho
why: Bina saboot ke vaada sirf daava lagta hai; jaldi proof aage ki baaton ko wazan deta hai
frequency: Har script; viral data kehta hai 4-7 s sabse achha
evidence_note: Melvynx viral measurements (proof by 4-7 s) + script trigger rule (proof before 8 s)

name: Triggers kam se kam 4, apni jagah par
when: Script likhne ke baad check karte waqt
action: Kam se kam 4 triggers sahi jagah rakho: curiosity gap (hook), self-recognition (hook/line 2), proof (8 s se pehle), enemy (problem par — tool/habit/myth, viewer kabhi nahi), pattern break (re-hook), specificity (fix me), loss/urgency (ask se pehle; fake scarcity kabhi nahi)
why: Script isiliye tikti hai kyunki har hissa sahi pal par ek lever kheenchta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules ka creator framework

name: Funnel: darwaza bada, pivot 20-35% par
when: Naye viewers tak pahunchne wali Teach/Opinion video par
action: M ya L size ke topic se kholo (bridge 0-3 s: debate, bada naam, sabki roz ki scene), tension 3-10 s, pivot script ke 20-35% par niche ki taraf modo, pearl (sabse mazboot line) sabse pehle likho; bridge par 2 test: niche tak 15 s ke andar pahunche? kal ko is viewer ko offer chahiye hoga?
why: Sirf niche ke topic par video chhote test group me hi marti hai; bada darwaza sahi viewer ko andar laata hai
frequency: Naye-reach wali videos par; pivot hamesha 20-35% band me
evidence_note: Melvynx funnel reference ka creator framework

name: Divisive bridge ke kaide
when: Funnel me behes wala bridge use karte waqt
action: Niche ke pehchane debate par ek paksh lo, ek sentence me kaho aur use fairly defend karo (pehle opposite ki ek line, phir apni wajah + example); hamla idea/habit/tool par ho, kisi person ya viewer group par kabhi nahi; CTA soft rakho (proximity 0-1)
why: Behes sabse chauda darwaza hai, lekin galat nishana rage-bait ban jata hai aur sakht sale usi pal bharosa tod deta hai
frequency: Divisive script me; bridge kabhi poori video nahi
evidence_note: Melvynx funnel reference ka creator framework

name: Hook khule, sirf ek baar repeat ho
when: Koi line hook bana kar cut ki shuruaat me rakho to
action: Hook line cut ko khole aur poori edit me apne context me sirf ek baar repeat ho; dusri baar repeat kabhi nahi
why: Reviewer ki standing pasand: ek repeat context deta hai, dusra repeat defect mana gaya (pipeline ke apne itihaas me repeat bug do baar lauta)
frequency: Har reel jisme hook prepend ho — repeat count theek 1
evidence_note: mktkit owner/reviewer ka house rule, QA gate (hook.once) se enforce hota hai
conflict_note: Ye sirf mktkit ka design rule hai; baaki teen sources me hook-repeat ka koi niyam nahi — aam taur par repeat ko galti hi mana jata hai, dusri pipeline me lagane se pehle socho

name: Chapters ke niyam
when: Lambi video (tutorial, podcast, explainer, lamba vlog) publish karte waqt
action: Pehla timestamp 00:00 ho, kam se kam 3 timestamps ascending order me, har chapter ≥10 s ka; timestamps edit ke asli times se lo, aankh se naap kar nahi
why: Viewer apne kaam ke hisse par seedha jump karta hai aur markers use wapas aana aasan karte hain (Guo 2014 me bhi yahi pattern)
evidence_note: YouTube official chapters spec (platform rule)

name: End screen aur closing
when: YouTube lambi video ke aakhir me
action: Aakhri 5-20 s end screen ke liye khaali rakho (video ≥25 s ho, ≤4 elements aayenge, wahan zaroori text mat rakho); closing ek sentence me batao aage kahan jana hai — lambi recap nahi
why: End screen elements content ko dhak dete hain; lambe sign-off par hi retention sabse tez girti hai
evidence_note: YouTube official end-screen spec (platform rule)

name: CTA ek line me, object ke saath
when: Video ke aakhir me ask rakhte waqt
action: Ek hi ask, ek line me, aur woh koi cheez de (repo, guide, prompt); Shorts me CTA card aakhri 2-3 s me; 'thanks for watching' ya bina exact shabd wala 'comment karo' nahi
why: CTA views nahi banata, comments/DMs banata hai — aur kai asks ek saath koi ask nahi banta
frequency: Har video me 1 ask; Offer video ke alawa soft
evidence_note: Melvynx viral measurements (CTA reach nahi banata) + shorts-codes ka house rule

name: Facts aur numbers invent mat karo
when: Script ya video me koi number, naam ya result aaye to
action: Number/naam/result sirf asal source se (creator ke diye hue facts); jo na mile use {{placeholder}} rakho aur 'bharna baki' me likho; koi figure bina source ke mat ghusao — source na ho to saaf kaho
why: Gadha hua number ek baar pakda jaye to poori channel ki baaton par bharosa jata hai
evidence_note: kmilo hard rule ('No invented numbers') + Melvynx facts rule — dono house/creator ethic

name: Licensed media hi; meme recreate karo
when: Music, SFX, footage ya meme use karte waqt
action: Sirf CC0, YouTube Audio Library, ya commercial use ki written license wala media lo; NC ya 'YouTube par mila hua' kabhi nahi; meme ka original media/music mat uthao — joke ko apne graphics se recreate karo
why: Monetized channel par ek claim poori video (aur channel) ko mehenga pad sakta hai
frequency: Har asset par; library me naya sound aaye to uska license evidence record karo
evidence_note: kmilo hard rule + licenses reference (house rule, legal risk par based)

name: Body ki banawat type ke hisaab se
when: Script ka body likhte waqt
action: Type-wise beats rakho — Teach: problem → kyun hota hai → fix (steps/ek move) → kya badlega; Proof: result+number → concretely kya kiya → copyable hissa → honest catch; Story: moment (mid-scene) → turn → ek line ka lesson; Opinion: position → opposite ko fairly → reason+example → kya karein; Talking head: cold open → context → sections (har section mini-hook se khule) → payoff
why: Har type ka viewer alag ummeed se aata hai; banawat wahi ummeed poori karti hai to beech me girawat nahi aati
frequency: Har script par uske type ki banawat
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules (body by type) + kmilo talking-head recipe structure

name: Week ka mix aur offer ki doori
when: Hafte ki scripts plan karte waqt
action: Pehle mix banao (5 me lagbhag Teach 2, Proof 1, Story 1, Opinion 1, Offer ≤1); ek hi hook formula lagatar do baar nahi, ek hi type hafte me teen baar nahi; offer proximity ladder 0-3 rakho — rung 3 hafte me ≤1 aur woh bhi sabse mazboot value video ke baad
why: Ek hi tarah ki videos thakati hain aur har video me bechna bharosa khatm karta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx week-mix aur offer-proximity house rules

name: Hit concept ko do hafte me repeat karo
when: Apna koi concept x3+ over-perform kare to
action: Use 2 hafte ke andar 2-3 naye hooks ya naye items ke saath repost karo, use 'luck' kehne se pehle
why: Jo shape ek baar median se kai guna gaya, woh recipe hai; dohraana hi use sabit karta hai
frequency: Har x3+ hit par, 14 din ke andar
evidence_note: Melvynx viral measurements ka rule (apne studied accounts par)

name: Retention report padh kar seekho
when: Video publish hone ke baad
action: Retention report dekho: jis moment par dip hai wahi agli baar cut/sudhar ka candidate hai; spikes (rewatch/share wale hisse) pehchano aur unhe dohraane ki koshish karo
why: Graph jhooth nahi bolta — dip aksar usi hisse par hota hai jo video ko aage nahi badhata
frequency: Har publish ke baad (key moments ≥60 s aur ≥100 views wali videos par milte hain)
evidence_note: YouTube official key-moments feature (platform data)

name: Script ki lines: ek saans, 4-15 shabd
when: Script likhte waqt
action: Ek line = ek sentence = ek saans, 4-15 shabd; abstract lines lagatar 3 nahi — teesri ko example bana do; ek viewer se baat karo ('you', 'you guys' nahi); chhote shabd, jo dost ko na kaho woh kato
why: Lambi, abstract lines bolne me bhi atakti hain aur sunne me bhi; ek-saans wali lines hi natural lagti hain
frequency: Har script ki har line par
evidence_note: Melvynx script-rules ka house style

name: AI wali banawat hatao (humanize)
when: Script ya koi bhi text finalize karne se pehle
action: AI ke nishan saaf karo: hype shabd (delve, unlock, game-changer jaisi khaali badi baatein) hatao ya number se badlo; preamble ('here's the thing') kato; recap ending hatao; engagement bait ('save this', 'tag someone') sirf asl ask se badlo; false contrast ('it's not X, it's Y') poori text me ≤1; tino-tino ki triads tod do
why: Chat-model jaisi banawat viewer ko turant 'ye asli insaan nahi' ka sanket deti hai aur bharosa girta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx ai-tells + humanize references ka creator framework

name: Clip standalone banao (long se short)
when: Lambi video se Short/Clip nikaalte waqt
action: Clip aisi jagah se kato jo bina context samajh aaye: pehli line 'so', 'as I said', 'this' jaisi bahari sahara wali na ho; ek hi idea poora ho; end finished thought par ho; long video ke references ('pichle part me') hata do; end payoff ya loop par
why: Jo clip context maangta hai woh feed me akela khada nahi ho pata
frequency: Har clip 20-60 s; Melvynx ka standalone score ≥7/10 (5 points × 0-2)
evidence_note: Melvynx clips skill ka scoring system + kmilo shorts recipe

name: B-roll exactness: bola wahi dikhe
when: Voice jo naam le use dikhaya ja sakta ho to
action: B-roll/punch wahi cheez literally dikhaye jo boli gayi (spoken noun phrase); exact asset na mile to speaker par hi raho — same-category ki tasveer (kisi bhi darwaze se 'hidden door') fallback nahi, defect hai; photo tabhi jab human-confirmed subject match kare, aur video hamesha photo se pehle
why: Alag ya sajawati visual dhyaan todta hai aur comprehension girata hai; exact visual baat ko pakka karta hai
evidence_note: Mayer (2008, peer-reviewed) ka coherence principle; mktkit ka owner rule ('exact or nothing', 2026-09-07) iska sakht roop hai — woh hissa 🟠

name: Graphic sirf jab samjhaye
when: Koi graphic ya on-screen text jodne se pehle
action: Graphic sirf tab: (1) jo camera nahi dikha sakta woh dikhana ho (concept, comparison, number, timeline, map), ya (2) structure mark karna ho (section title, naam, step counter); jo graphic hatane se kuch na ghate woh hatao; voice ki baat ko text me mat dohrao — text woh ho jo bola nahi gaya (naam, number, key term)
why: Shabd + tasveer saath sikhati hai, lekin bekaar graphic aur dohra hua text dono seekhna aur samajh girate hain
evidence_note: Mayer (2008, peer-reviewed) — multimedia, coherence aur redundancy principles

name: Graphic kabhi khaali nahi, word se bandha ho
when: Koi card, table ya graphic screen par aaye to
action: Graphic use shabd se zyada se zyada 0.5 s pehle enter kare jo use introduce karta hai; pehla content element 1 s ke andar aa jaye; har row/element us shabd ke ≤0.6 s ke andar enter kare jo use naam de; koi card 1 s se zyada khaali na rahe; aakhri phrase ke ~1.2 s baad graphic chala jaye; elements even stagger se nahi, shabdo se bandh kar aayein
why: Khaali frame intezaar karta hua graphic galti lagta hai aur viewer ka dhyaan wahi atakta hai
evidence_note: kmilo house rules (reference tutorial ke pehle cut ki review se bane)

name: On-screen text ka reading-time formula
when: Koi bhi text screen par rahe to
action: Text ki duration = max(1.5 s; words × 0.33 s + 0.5 s) rakho (0.33 s/shabd = 160-180 wpm padhne ki gati); jo label voice ke saath jata hai woh apne shabd ke saath enter kare aur bole jaane ke 0.6 s baad tak rahe — formula se kam kabhi nahi
why: Jaldi gayab text padha hi nahi jata; padhne se pehle use dhoondhne ka bhi samay lagta hai (+0.5 s isiliye)
evidence_note: BBC subtitle guidelines (160-180 wpm) se derived; +0.5 s aur label wala hissa kmilo house

name: Captions ke standard specs
when: Closed captions/subtitles banate waqt
action: ≤42 characters per line, ≤2 lines; reading speed ≤20 characters/s (bachchon ke liye 17); har event ≥20 frames (≈0.83 s); events ke beech gap ≥2 frames; line break punctuation ke baad ya conjunction/preposition se pehle rakho — article ko noun se, pehle naam ko upnaam se kabhi mat todo
why: Ye duniya bhar ke broadcast specs hain — inse tez ya lambe captions padhe nahi jate
evidence_note: Netflix Timed Text Style Guide (platform/broadcast spec)
conflict_note: mktkit vertical (1080 px wide) ke liye 32 chars × 2 lines rakhta hai kyunki wahan 42 fit nahi hota (DCMP Captioning Key bhi 32 kehta hai) — vertical me 32, 16:9 standard captions me 42

name: Caption cue join cross na kare, shabd drop na ho
when: Captions ko edit points ke saath rakhte waqt
action: Cue kabhi edit join ko cross na kare (har spine boundary par cue split karo); rakha hua koi shabd caption se drop na ho; speech agar cut ke 0.5 s ke andar shuru/khatm ho to cue ko cut par hi rakho, cross sirf tab jab speech khud cross kare
why: Join ke paar latka caption galti dikhta hai; range ke aakhir ke chhote shabd clamp me gayab hona ek asal defect raha hai
evidence_note: Netflix timing guide ke shot-change rules (platform spec) + mktkit ka engine-enforced house rule

name: Burned-in social captions ka tareeka
when: Shorts/Reels/TikTok ke liye captions burn karte waqt
action: Captions word-timed rakho; chunk chhota rakho; bola ja raha shabd accent color/highlight me dikhao; badi bold sans-serif, outline ya box ke saath; har page ≥20 frames rahe; jab board wahi shabd dikha raha ho to captions hide karo; numbers ko digits me likho (shabdon me nahi); caption engine ke defaults: min cue 0.8 s, max cue 2.8 s
why: 80%+ viewers muted ya kam awaaz me dekhte hain — wahan captions hi awaaz hain
evidence_note: Creator practice teeno sources me; muted-viewing wala aankda Melvynx shorts-codes ka (80%+)
conflict_note: Chunk size par farak: Melvynx 1-3 words per chunk, kmilo 1-5 words per page — dono chalte hain, ek channel par ek hi style consistent rakho

name: Safe zones: text platform UI se bahar
when: 9:16 video me text, captions ya CTA rakhte waqt
action: Text aur key visuals platform UI bands ke bahar rakho. Universal 9:16 zone: x 9-91%, y 14-86%; hook text y 15-22%; captions/CTA y 78% se neeche nahi; right 14% me kuch zaroori nahi. Pixel hisaab (1080x1920, mktkit): IG/FB top 270 bottom 672, TikTok top 130 bottom 484, Shorts top 180 bottom 350 — kai platforms ke liye sabse sakht intersection lo aur caption MarginV = strictest bottom + 24 px. 1:1/16:9 me text beech ke 80% me rakho
why: UI ke neeche dabaa text padha hi nahi jata — ye retention nahi, seedha samajh ka nuksaan hai
frequency: Har text placement par; check number se karo (text safe jab y ≥14, y+h ≤79, x+w ≤86)
evidence_note: mktkit ke specs Meta/TikTok sourced (platform specs); ExpoCut ke % vendor-measured (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com); Melvynx ke px zones house-measured
conflict_note: Sources ke numbers format aur platform ke hisaab se alag hain: Melvynx px (top 220, bottom 420, right 140 from y900) ExpoCut ke % aur mktkit ke px se thode alag hain — target platforms ka sakht intersection hi surakshit raasta hai

name: Phone par padhai: size aur contrast
when: Koi text screen par aaye to
action: Body text 1080p par ≥40-60 px uncha rakho; contrast ≥4.5:1; video ke upar text ko solid/scrim card ya outline do; label fit karne ke liye font chhota mat karo — label ke shabd chhote karo
why: Chhota ya halka text phone par gayab ho jata hai; jo padha na jaye woh information nahi, shor hai
frequency: Har text par; Melvynx ke floors: UI detail ≥34 px, labels 38-42 px, captions ~84 px
evidence_note: WCAG AA contrast 4.5:1 (WebAIM standard) + legibility.info; px floors creator practice

name: Boards illustrate karein, paraphrase nahi
when: Short me board/visual element lagate waqt
action: Board sirf woh dikhaye jo dikhaya ja sakta hai: number, command, folder, asli logo, before/after, asli screen; bola hua paraphrase karke board mat banao; board par 2-4 shabd se zyada text nahi; teen text-board lagatar nahi; har board theek us shabd par land kare jo use naam de
why: Jo board baat ko dohraata hai woh screen bharta hai, samajh nahi; jo dikhata hai woh baat ko pakka karta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx short-editing style.md ka house rule

name: Tutorial me screen lead kare, voice follow
when: Screen tutorial edit karte waqt
action: Screen jo dikhaye voice wahi kahe, usi pal: phrase tab aaye jab uska action screen par ho; phrase action se lambi ho to result ko usi second par freeze karo; clip kabhi peeche na jaye, na kisi chhode hue clip par wapas aaye
why: Shabd aur tasveer ka saath (temporal contiguity) hi tutorial ko follow karne layak banata hai; aage-peeche hona sabse bada confusion hai
evidence_note: kmilo house rule (reference tutorial review se); peeche Mayer ka temporal contiguity principle (🟢) khada hai

name: Tutorial chapter cards aur edge badge
when: Tutorial ke chapter badlein to
action: Har chapter 3 s ke title card se khule ('Step 2 of 5'), card ka content 0.55 s me enter kare; screen par step ke naam ka edge badge rakho taaki beech me land karne wale ko jagah samajh aaye; chapter ke andar hard cuts hi rakho
why: Tutorial viewers hisse dohraate aur jump karte hain; bade, saaf markers unhe sahi jagah pahunchaate hain
evidence_note: kmilo house rule; Guo 2014 (🟡) ka bade-text-at-transitions wala support

name: Lower third pehli pehchan par
when: Podcast/interview me koi vyakti pehli baar dikhe to
action: Us vyakti ka naam aur role lower third me dikhao, aur lambe break ke baad dobara dikhao
why: Bina pehchan ke viewer baat ko sahi insaan se jod nahi pata
frequency: Har naye speaker ki pehli appearance par
evidence_note: kmilo podcast recipe ka creator practice

name: Auto captions review zaroor karo
when: Publish se pehle captions finalize karte waqt
action: YouTube ke auto captions ko bina review publish mat karo (accent, dialect, background noise se woh speech ko galat dikha sakte hain) — caption file upload karo ya auto wali sudharo; burned-in ho to word-by-word check karo; numbers hamesha video se verify karo
why: Galat caption samajh ko ulta kar deta hai, aur burn ho jaye to galti permanent dikhti hai
evidence_note: YouTube official auto-caption warning (platform) + Melvynx clips ki practical chetaavni

name: Music awaaz se 18-25 dB neeche
when: Bolne ke neeche music lage to
action: Background music ko voice se 18-25 dB neeche rakho (voice -16 LUFS ho to music lagbhag -34/-41 LUFS)
why: Awaaz se ladta music seedha samajh khatm karta hai — viewer shabd pakadne me thakta hai
frequency: Jahan bhi speech ke neeche music hai
evidence_note: Creator source (Pure Audio Insight) kmilo ki tagging me; koi peer-reviewed number nahi
conflict_note: Melvynx ke measured style-copy me ek creator ka beat ~12 dB under naapa gaya tha — woh us style ka naapa hua apvaad hai; aam niyam 18-25 dB hi hai, copy karna ho to original ko naapo (dekho A-091)

name: Ducking: bolte waqt music 6-12 dB dabao
when: Speech ke neeche music chale to
action: Jab koi bole to music ko 6-12 dB duck karo — soft attack 10-50 ms, release 250-700 ms (sidechain compressor, auto-ducking ya keyframes se); Melvynx ke mix defaults: bed -28 LUFS, duck ratio 0.5
why: Ducking se music rehta bhi hai aur shabd saaf bhi rehte hain; bina duck ke ya to music gayab ya awaaz dabti hai
evidence_note: Creator sources (Zella; Auphonic ka official default 18 dB apne tool ke liye hai — isiliye range 6-12 creator wali rakhi)

name: SFX ke level aur jagah ke niyam
when: Sound effect lagate waqt
action: SFX voice se 12-24 dB neeche rakho; effect ka transient visual change se 2-4 frames pehle rakho taaki peak dikhne ke pal mile; key word (number, naam) ke upar effect kabhi nahi; ek hi sound lagatar 3 baar se zyada nahi; jo awaaz asal recording me pehle se kaam kar rahi hai (real click, darwaza) us par effect mat chadhao; gain ke default andaze: SFX ~15 dB, ambience ~30 dB under
why: Galat jagah ya zyada tez effect shabd ko kha jata hai; sahi jagah wala effect dikhne wali cheez ko pakka karta hai
evidence_note: Creator sources (Storyblocks) + kmilo library ke house defaults

name: Master loudness destination ke hisaab se
when: Final master banate waqt
action: Ek hi master, destination ke target par, naap kar (guess nahi): YouTube ke liye -14 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤-1 dBTP; podcast feed ke liye -16 LKFS ±1; dono jagah jana ho to do masters banao; loudnorm two-pass lagao (pehle measure, phir linear apply)
why: Zyada loud ghusane se kuch nahi milta (platform neeche kar dega), bahut kam rakho to padosi videos se halka sunai dega
frequency: Har export par ek master; mktkit apni pipeline me -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP / LRA 11 rakhta hai
evidence_note: Apple Podcasts official spec + YouTube ke measured normalization behaviour + EBU R128 references — platform specs
conflict_note: YouTube target -14 LUFS (kmilo/Melvynx) vs mktkit ka house master -16 LUFS: dono apni jagah sahi hain — mktkit ka tark hai ki -16 wala master platform ke ~-14 normalization par bina limiting artifacts ke pahunchta hai; jo pipeline chuno, ek hi target rakho

name: Room tone har gap ke neeche
when: Recording aur edit dono par
action: Har location par 30-60 s ka room tone record karo; edit me har cut-gap ke neeche wahi bichao — awaaz kabhi digital silence par na gire; room tone na ho to recording ke sabse saaf khaali hisse se copy karo
why: Digital silence dropout jaisi lagti hai aur har cut par background ka jump sunai deta hai
evidence_note: Creator source (StudioBinder) — kmilo ki tagging me creator

name: Dialogue saaf karne ka kram
when: Voice/dialogue clean karte waqt
action: Isi kram me chalo: sabse achha source/mic chuno (jo na bole uske mics mute) → halki noise reduction → high-pass ~80 Hz → EQ (clarity) → compression → de-esser (zarurat ho to) → har clip ka level barabar → aakhir me ek master; har breath mat hatao, awaaz robotic ho jati hai
why: Har kadam pichle ke output par behtar kaam karta hai; ulta kram artefacts banata hai
frequency: Har video ki dialogue processing par
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo audio reference)

name: Gain andaze se nahi, formula se
when: Kisi sound ko voice ke neeche set karte waqt
action: Gain hamesha naap kar nikalo: gain = 10^((voice_lufs − under − sound_lufs)/20), cap 1 par; 'under' ke defaults — SFX 15 dB, music ~20 dB, ambience/room tone ~30 dB; gain 1 se upar aaye to woh sound us kaam ke liye halka hai, dusra chuno, amplify mat karo
why: Andaze wale levels har video me badalte rehte hain; formula har baar wahi rishta deta hai
evidence_note: kmilo house method (library ke measured catalog par chalta hai)

name: Podcast mics: jo na bole uska band
when: Multicam podcast/interview edit karte waqt
action: Jo vyakti nahi bol raha uska mic mute ya gate karo (dusri awaaz late pakad kar echo/phasing na bane); sab speakers ka level ek barabar rakho; music sirf intro, outro aur topic breaks me rakho, baat-cheet ke neeche nahi
why: Khule mics ka echo aur alag-alag levels hi podcast ko sabse zyada 'amateur' sunate hain
evidence_note: kmilo podcast recipe ka creator practice

name: Join fades: cut par click na aaye
when: Talking spine ke segments judte hon to
action: Har kept segment ke join par 0.05-0.08 s ka audio fade rakho
why: Bina fade ke range joins click karte hain — chhoti awaaz, lekin har cut par sunne wale ko khichti hai
evidence_note: mktkit cut-video engine ka rule (reviewer catches se bana)

name: Visual change ki cadence (short-form)
when: Short-form (TikTok/Reels/Shorts) edit karte waqt
action: Har kuch seconds me screen par kuch badal ho — baseline: 5 s ke andar kam se kam ek visual change (cut, punch-in, overlay, B-roll, text swap); ExpoCut ki kasauti: koi bhi 5 s ka window bina change ke = swipe risk
why: Short-form me rukti hui screen hi swipe ka sabse seedha karan hai
frequency: Pacing offsets: Melvynx har 2-4 s, ExpoCut har 3-5 s, mktkit har 3-7 s (pehle 5 s me aur tight), trend/entertainment me cuts 0.5-1 s
evidence_note: Teeno sources creator playbook/house numbers hain (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com — ExpoCut ka hissa)
conflict_note: Cadence ke numbers sources me alag hain — Melvynx 2-4 s, ExpoCut 3-5 s, mktkit 3-7 s; content type faisla kare (samjhane wala dheema, entertainment tez), lekin 5 s se upar kahin bharosa nahi

name: Film se pacing ka benchmark
when: Kisi bhi format ka shot length sochte waqt
action: Reference rakho: aaj ki filmein ~4-5 s average shot length par chalti hain; dialogue wale hisse isse lambe, action wale chhote; apne format ka pacing isi ke aas-paas napo, usse bad-zada tez mat karo
why: Ye das saal ke data ka pattern hai — viewer's aankh is cadence ki aadi hai
frequency: Sirf benchmark; koi sakht target nahi
evidence_note: James Cutting (2011) — peer-reviewed film data (kmilo me 'study / official' tag)
conflict_note: Ye film ka naapa hua average hai, short-form ke liye target nahi — wahan cadence A-051 wali hi chalegi

name: Type ke hisaab se shot lambaai
when: Har segment ka shot length tay karte waqt
action: Talking head: 2-5 s per shot; verticals: 2-3 s per shot, 4 s se upar kabhi nahi, aur text wala shot kam se kam ~2 s; tutorial: shot ≥5 s; vlog: clock se nahi, event ke hisaab se kato (ek kaam = ek block)
why: Har format ki samajh-gati alag hai — tutorial ko sochne ka samay chahiye, vertical ko nahi
evidence_note: kmilo creator reference (type-wise shot lengths)

name: Explainer ke pattern interrupts
when: Lambe explainer/talking video me dhyaan bachana ho to
action: Pehla pattern interrupt (angle, B-roll, graphic, zoom) 25-35 s ke andar laao, phir har 2-3 minute me ek; micro-hook (caption, question, tease) isse ghana rakho
why: Bina badlaav ke dhyaan sabse tez yahi girta hai — interrupt ek nayi shuruaat jaisa kaam karta hai
frequency: Pehla ≤35 s par; phir 2-3 min ke antar par; micro-hook har 30-90 s
evidence_note: Creator source (air.io) kmilo me; micro-hook ke numbers TubeBuddy/vidIQ ke alag-alag reports hain
conflict_note: Micro-hook interval par sources aapas me takrate hain — TubeBuddy 30-60 s kehta hai, vidIQ 60-90 s; dono creator reports hain, koi pakka number nahi

name: Phrases ke beech ka gap
when: Dead air/silence hatate waqt
action: Phrase gaps type ke hisaab se rakho: talking head 200-400 ms, Shorts 200-300 ms, tutorial ≥0.4 s (3 s bina voice = warning, 6 s = hard cap jab tak screen khud na samjhaye); saans ki jagah puri tarah zero mat karo — gap hamesha kuch rakho
why: Saans hi bolne ko insaani banati hai; gap type ke samajh-waqt ke barabar ho to edit natural lagta hai
evidence_note: Creator/house numbers teeno sources se (kmilo, Melvynx pauses.json defaults, mktkit engine defaults)
conflict_note: Numbers style ke hisaab se bahut alag hain: Melvynx ka super-fast style sirf 30-80 ms saans rakhta hai (sentence .08, comma .05, word .03); mktkit engine defaults talking 0.40 s, manifest 0.85 s; ExpoCut silence removal me min gap 450-500 ms + 80 ms padding (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com) — ek channel par ek style pakdo

name: Har cut ke paas reason ho
when: Koi cut lagane se pehle
action: Cut tabhi jab woh ek kaam kare: (1) dead time hataye, (2) information badle, ya (3) action ko follow kare; word ke beech me cut kabhi nahi
why: Bina reason ke cut viewer ko jhatka deta hai; reason wala cut dikhai hi nahi deta
evidence_note: kmilo house rule (yeh editor test); YouTube official bhi 'cuts that do not serve a purpose confuse viewers' kehta hai

name: Cut on action
when: Movement ke beech cut aaye to
action: Cut ko khud movement par rakho (darwaza khulna, haath uthna) — movement cut ko dhak deta hai; gesture ya blink ke beech me cut mat karo; classic tareeka: aankhon par ya sentence par cut
why: Aankh movement ko follow karti hai, isliye wahan cut chhup jata hai
evidence_note: kmilo editing reference ka creator practice

name: J/L cuts scene badlaav naram karne ke liye
when: Scene ya speaker badle aur transition kathin lage to
action: Agli awaaz ko tasveer se pehle aane do (J cut) ya pichli awaaz ko tasveer badalne ke baad rehne do (L cut); offset kuch frames se ~2 s tak; tutorial me inka istemal kam
why: Awaaz ka nirantar flow scene ka badlaav mehsoos hi nahi hone deta
frequency: Scene/speaker changes par zarurat ke hisaab se
evidence_note: Creator source (TechSmith) — offset ke liye koi pakka number source nahi deta

name: Jump cuts ka sahi istemal
when: Single-camera talking head se filler hatana ho to
action: Jump cuts hi sahi tareeka hain; inhe naram karne ke liye alternate cut par punch-in ya B-roll cover lagao; interview/multicam me jab asli angle maujood hai to jump cut kabhi nahi; subject ko mid-gesture me pakde hue mat chhodo
why: YouTube khud tight talking head ke liye jump cuts ki salah deta hai; bina cover ke lagatar jump cuts kathin lagte hain
frequency: Har take me filler positions par
evidence_note: YouTube official recommendation (platform) + kmilo creator refinements

name: Pacing varied rakho, metronome nahi
when: Poori edit ka rhythm banate waqt
action: Tez hisso ke baad wohi lamba hold rakho jahan key point land karta hai; ek hi scene ke andar bhi sabse dheemi animation sabse tez ki ~3 guna ho sakti hai; har cheez ko ek hi gati par mat chalao
why: Ek-si gati thoda samay baad sunai/dikhai dena band ho jati hai; contrast hi dhyaan banata hai
evidence_note: kmilo creator rules + motion-principles reference

name: Cuts music ki phrase par
when: Music ke saath edit karte waqt
action: Cuts aur loops music ki phrases par rakho, mid-note par nahi; video ka ant music ke asli ending ya saaf fade par ho; foreground music (music video/promo) me key cuts downbeat par rakho; music-led video me cuts beats par rakho
why: Phrase ke beech kata music bina bole hi galat lagta hai; phrase par kata hua mehsoos hi nahi hota
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo music reference; ExpoCut ke music-beat cuts iske saath — Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Punch ki hadd: lambaai, doori, ginti
when: Talking reel me visual punch (clip/still/board/super) lagate waqt
action: Clip punch <3.0 s rakho (zyada lamba = woh cutaway ho gaya); still punch 3.5 s; super wala segment 3.5-4.0 s; do punches ke beech A-roll ≥3.0 s rakho, warna punches ko butt karo; punches ≤10/min; stills ≤2 per reel aur lagatar kabhi nahi; still apne noun ke 0.3 s ke andar shuru ho, clip punch ki window 0.8 s
why: Bina hadd ke punches poori reel ko shor bana dete hain aur punch ka matlab hi khatm ho jata hai
frequency: Har reel par (yeh mktkit ke QA gates se enforce hote hain)
evidence_note: mktkit owner/reviewer ke khade kiye hue rules (asal reviewer catches se bane)

name: B-roll ki ginti (paper-stage shorts)
when: Short ke liye B-roll lagate waqt (Melvynx system)
action: B-roll zyada se zyada har 8-15 s me ek, 2-5 s ka; do B-roll ke beech ~5 s creator screen par; clip tabhi jab image sentence se fit ho; achha hit na mile to board ya creator hi rakho, random clip kabhi nahi
why: Har doosri line par clip pura lagne ki jagah pura hi bekaar lagta hai; kam aur fit B-roll hi premium feel deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx shorts broll house rules
conflict_note: mktkit ke punch system me punches 10/min (har ~6 s) tak ja sakte hain — woh talking-reel ka alag system hai; ye 8-15 s wali cadence paper-stage shorts ki hai; format ke hisaab se chuno, dono ko mat milao

name: Retakes aur false starts hatao
when: Talking footage ki pehli safaai karte waqt
action: Har line ka aakhra complete attempt rakho; false starts, half-words, 'uh', off-script awaazein ('wait, redo that') drop karo; chhupe retake ke nishan pehchano: 0.6 s se lamba koi shabd, bola hua phrase dohraaya, ya be-matlab shabd
why: Retake wali gandagi hi raw footage ko amateur banati hai; saaf spine ke bina koi style kaam nahi karta
frequency: Har take par, style se pehle
evidence_note: Melvynx script-first pipeline ka house rule + kmilo retake rules

name: Podcast me camera jo bole us par
when: Multicam podcast/interview cut karte waqt
action: Jo bol raha hai uska close-up rakho; speaker badle to badlaav ke ek beat baad cut karo; reaction shot sirf tab jab woh kuch kahe; wide shot shuruaat, topic change aur cross-talk ke liye rakho; timer par angle kabhi mat badlo; lambi monologue me close/medium/wide ya punch-in ghumao
why: Camera speaker ko follow kare to baat-cheet dekhna aasan hota hai; timer wale cuts nakli lagte hain
frequency: Poore episode par; koi pakki frequency nahi — speaker changes hi trigger hain
evidence_note: kmilo podcast recipe; source khud kehta hai iske liye koi authoritative frequency number nahi hai

name: Hard-out hamesha shabd ke end par
when: Clip ya reel ka ant tay karte waqt
action: Video ka end hamesha aakhri rakhe hue shabd ke END par rakho; ant kabhi SRT cue ke end se mat nikalo (wah aadha sentence late ho sakta hai)
why: Cue timing aur asli awaaz ka end alag hote hain — galat ant par video latka hua ya kata hua lagta hai
evidence_note: mktkit cut-video engine ka rule (asal defect se bana)

name: Tutorial shots aur speed
when: Tutorial edit karte waqt
action: Shots ≥5 s rakho; navigation, clicks aur results 1x par; typing zyada se zyada 1.5x; dead time ko speed se nahi, clean cut se hatao; app ki apni animation (modal khulna, loading) ke beech cut mat karo; form kabhi screen par kata hua mat dikhao (submit sirf clicked state me)
why: Tutorial ka kaam follow karwana hai — tez ya kata hua step viewer ko kho deta hai
evidence_note: kmilo house rules (reference tutorial review se)

name: Bolne ki gati type ke hisaab se
when: Script ki lambaai aur pace tay karte waqt
action: Technical/tutorial narration 120-150 wpm rakho; short script ka default pace ~160 wpm; script ki lambaai shabdo ki ginti ko pace se bhaag de kar napo (bole hue runtime ke hisaab se likho)
why: Gati hi samajh ka samay deti hai; tez script bechne me bhi aur samjhane me bhi haarti hai
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo pacing + Melvynx script-length defaults)

name: Short ki lambaai ke targets
when: Short-form video ki lambaai tay karte waqt
action: Targets rakho lekin idea ko lambaai tay karne do, platform ki max ko nahi: TikTok entertainment 21-34 s (educational 60-90 s), Shorts 15-30 s, Reels 7-15 s punchy ya 30-60 s value; Melvynx ke naape hue hits 25-40 s aur 30-60 s aam range hai, 45 s se neeche completion behtar
why: Jo lambaai idea se zyada hai woh completion% gira kar video ko dabati hai
evidence_note: Creator guidance (ExpoCut playbook — Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com; Melvynx ke measured ranges)

name: Lambe content ko 6 min ke blocks me baanto
when: Lamba educational content banate waqt
action: Content ko 6 minute se chhote blocks/chapters me baanto; lambi process ho to ek step = ek video rakho
why: Measured data (6.9M sessions) me 6 minute ke baad engagement girna shuru hota hai — chhote blocks wale videos zyada dekhe jate hain
frequency: Har lambe video ki planning par
evidence_note: Guo et al. 2014 — edX ke 6.9 million sessions ka measured study

name: Verify loop: dikhane se pehle filmstrip check
when: Render ya delivery se pehle
action: Poori video ko filmstrip/contact sheet par check karo: pehle 3 s (hook frame 0 par padh sakte ho?), poori lambaai (koi 5 s window bina change ke to nahi?), text ke safe-zone numbers (y ≥14, y+h ≤79, x+w ≤86); mktkit ka machine QA gate pass karo; render se pehle stills par iterate karo — stills seconds me bante hain, renders minutes me
why: Jo galti sheet par dikh jati hai woh publish ke baad pakadne se sasti padti hai; aadha kaam yahi pakda jata hai
evidence_note: Teeno sources ke house QA workflows (ExpoCut SVR loop — Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com; mktkit gate; Melvynx stills rule)

name: Punch-in sirf motivated, hadd ke andar
when: Talking video me zoom/punch-in lagane se pehle
action: Zoom sirf us detail, reaction ya usi line par rakho jis par voice baat kar rahi hai; talking-head punch-in ka scale 110-120% rakho (source resolution ke andar hi, soft frame crop nahi); Melvynx ke naape hue limits: punch-in har ~4 s se zyada baar nahi, ≤1.15x, agle cut tak hold, ek hi shot me in aur out dono nahi; zoom cut ko kabhi cross na kare; screencast me do zooms ke beech 5-7 s ka gap
why: Bina wajah ka zoom sabse pehchani jaane wali amatuer harkat hai; wajah wala zoom dhyaan ko sahi jagah le jata hai
evidence_note: Creator practice (kmilo; Envision ke screencast numbers) + Melvynx measured style-copy ke exact numbers
conflict_note: ExpoCut cadence ke saath har 2nd ya 3rd cut par punch-in ki salah deta hai (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com) — ye kmilo/Melvynx ke 'sirf motivated' niyam se takrata hai; entertainment short me cadence wali chal sakti hai, samjhane wale content me motivated wali hi surakshit hai

name: Snap punch-in ki technique
when: Punch-in lagate waqt (ExpoCut tareeka)
action: Zoom ko ramp mat karo — do hold keyframes lagao (jaise scale 1.0 se 1.1), cut par alternate karo; agar settle chahiye to easeOut key rakho aur 400 ms baad scale 1.0 wapas karo
why: Ramp wala zoom dheere-dheere ghista hua lagta hai; snap cut jaisa saaf lagta hai
frequency: ExpoCut style wale har punch-in par
evidence_note: ExpoCut playbook ki technique (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Entrances aur exits ki timing
when: Koi element screen par aaye ya jaye to
action: Cards/headlines 0.35-0.6 s ease-out me enter karein (bounce nahi), rows 0.3 s; exit hamesha entrance se chhota (0.25 s); elements 20-40 px offset aur opacity ke saath slide-in karein; Melvynx ka niyam: exit entrance se chhota rakho (.26 s smoothstep), theek 0 par khatm karo — spring wala exit ghost chhodta hai; springs kabhi overshoot na karein
why: Yahi chhoti timings 'professional' aur 'PPT jaisa' ke beech ka farak hain
evidence_note: kmilo motion reference (Material Design ke UI numbers 225/195 ms sirf reference ke roop me) + Melvynx reads ke measured exits

name: Bounce, elastic aur emoji nahi
when: Animation style ya visual language chunte waqt
action: Serious content par bounce/elastic easing kabhi nahi (sirf halka overshoot promotional CTA par chal sakta hai); ye bilkul mat use karo: pulse, bounce, elastic, overshoot, glow, shake, spin, confetti; beat ko emoji se illustrate mat karo — motion design, asal logo ya typography use karo
why: Ye effects video ko sasta aur baccho jaisa dikhate hain; ek forbidden cheez poora premium feel tod deti hai
frequency: Har project par (style system me band)
evidence_note: kmilo forbidden list + Melvynx motion rules — dono house style

name: Ek moment, ek hi accent color
when: Board ya graphic design karte waqt
action: Kisi ek pal me screen par sirf ek accent color rakho; dusra accent kabhi na aaye
why: Do accents ek saath ladte hain aur design ka focus khatm ho jata hai
evidence_note: Melvynx design system ka rule

name: Har beat action, khadi tasveer nahi
when: Koi beat banate waqt
action: Har beat kuch karta hua ho — screenshot, still illustration, akela logo ya text card screen par 'baitha' rahe to woh beat redo hai; screenshot sirf reference hai — UI ko recreate karke animate karo
why: Ruki hui screen hi short ko marta hai; action hi premium motion ka ehsaas deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx short-editing style.md ka rule

name: Hero then place; ek idea ek tableau
when: Naya object screen par laate waqt
action: Naya object pehle bada aur center me dikhao (scale 1.3-1.7), phir apni jagah (slot) me glide karo, aur agla item aane se pehle use land kar do; ek idea ke saare sentences ek hi tableau par badhte rahein — board har 1.5-2.5 s tabhi badlo jab speech ka idea badle; board ≥3 s hold ho to .025 ka slow push-in rakho
why: Bade pehle dikhne se aankh samajhti hai kya aa raha hai; tableau badalte rehne se viewer har baar nayi jagah seekhta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx style.md hero-then-place aur tableau rules

name: Asli logos hi, nakli kabhi nahi
when: Screen par kisi tool/product ka naam aaye to
action: Us tool ka asal logo/icon rakho (press kit, App Store listing ya official site se); letter glyph, emoji ya look-alike kabhi nahi; logo na mile to creator se file mango, khud mat banao
why: Nakli logo ek jhalak me pakda jata hai aur poori video ki credibility gira deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx style.md logo rule

name: Layout teen tarah ka ghumao
when: Short ka layout banate waqt
action: Teen views ghumao: split (paper/board upar, camera neeche — aam), paper-only (bada moment: key number ya screen), full camera (story, emotion, punchline, CTA — ≥5 s ke stretches); proof (paper) aur face (full camera) ko alternate karo taaki aankh ko aaram mile
why: Ek hi layout poori video me monotonous lagta hai; layout ka badlaav hi bina effect ke variety deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx edit skill ke teen layouts

name: Hook ka visual ek mini-story ho
when: Hook ka visual design karte waqt
action: Hook ka visual 2-3 acts ki mini-story ho — reversal ke saath, kai layers saath move karein, har keyword par impact (stamp + thud) aaye, aur payoff badge ki tarah land kare; ek object rakh kar use slide kar dena kaafi nahi
why: Hook ka visual hi pehle 2 s me 'ye alag hai' ka saboot hai; sust visual vaade ko khokhla kar deta hai
evidence_note: Melvynx hook-design reference (house craft)

name: Music bed emotion se chuno, dohrao mat
when: Short ke liye music bed chunte waqt
action: Bed ko hook ke emotion se chuno; busy ya dynamic track voice ke neeche kabhi mat rakho (aise tracks test me reject ho chuke hain); pichle short me use hua bed is short me dobara mat use karo
why: Galat bed poori video ka mood ulta kar deta hai, aur dohraaya bed 'wahi purana' ka ehsaas deta hai
frequency: Har short par nayi bed chuno
evidence_note: Melvynx music defaults aur test-rejected tracks ka house record

name: Music ka offset payoff par land karana
when: Track ko timeline par rakhte waqt
action: Bade payoff ko track ke kisi mazboot pal par land karana ho to offset = c − P rakho (jaise full section payoff par aaye, usse pehle 10-20 s ka break pocket ho); full-camera emotional line ke liye offset = brk − E; aam default: offset = a point (10 s ki intro skip, pulse frame 1 se); offset + lambaai kabhi track ke 'out' pal se aage na jaye
why: Track ka sabse mazboot pal video ke sabse mazboot pal par mile to dono ek dusre ko uthate hain
evidence_note: Melvynx edit plan ke music rules (reads se naape gaye a/b/brk/c points)

name: Movement shor nahi, sirf payoff hits
when: Sound design/hits lagate waqt
action: Thud sirf number land/die hone par, pop sirf asal arrival par rakho; ek aam short me music ke alawa 2-4 sounds hi rakho; entrance clicks, whooshes aur risers copy ya add mat karo (riser bhi shor hai — sirf hit bache); bundled hit gains: impact-boom −8 dB, zhhh −6 dB, riser −12 dB (voice ke neeche)
why: Har harkat par awaaz lagane se awaaz ka matlab khatm ho jata hai; kam aur sahi jagah wale hits hi mehsoos hote hain
frequency: Har short par 2-4 sounds (music se alag)
evidence_note: Melvynx style-steal learnings (galat copies ko reject karke bane house rules)

name: Color grade ka kram aur shot matching
when: Color correction/grade karte waqt
action: Isi kram me chalo: pehle normalize (log ko delivery color space me) → exposure scopes se set karo → white balance → scene ke saare shots ko hero shot se match karo (consistent grade hi sabse bada professional farak hai) → look/LUT aakhir me, sirf normalized footage par; skin tones ka red/green ka santulan mat bigado; screens aur graphics ko kabhi grade mat karo
why: Galat kram me grade karne se har shot alag lagta hai aur look footage ko tod deta hai
evidence_note: kmilo color reference (creator practice) + Melvynx grade system ka ek hi kram

name: Transitions ke matlab
when: Do shots ke beech transition chunte waqt
action: Har transition ka apna matlab rakho: cut = nirantarta (continuity), dissolve = samay/jagah/topic ka badlaav, fade to black = ek block ka ant; Premiere ka default dissolve 1 s hai — use tabhi rakho jab badlaav asal me ho; flashy transitions (spin, glitch) har cut par kabhi nahi
why: Har cut par flashy transition dhyaan ko kahani se hata kar khud par le jata hai
evidence_note: Creator source (StudioBinder) + Adobe official docs

name: Thumbnail ke niyam
when: YouTube thumbnail banate waqt
action: File 1920×1080 JPG, 2 MB se kam; text 1-5 shabd (ideal 3-4) heavy sans-serif me, ~180 px par padh sakne wale; thumbnail title ko repeat na kare — use complement kare; ek hi dominant subject, 2-3 elements se zyada nahi; bottom-right corner khaali rakho (duration wahan aata hai); thumbnail jo vaada kare woh video ke pehle 30 s me milna chahiye
why: Mobile feed me thumbnail chhota dikhta hai — wahan padh sakne wala, ek-subject wala design hi click lata hai, aur jhootha vaada retention ko marta hai
evidence_note: YouTube official spec (1920×1080, <2 MB) + creator testing ke legibility numbers

name: Title ke niyam
when: Video ka title likhte waqt
action: Title 100 characters ke andar rakho, zaroori hissa pehle ~60 characters me; search video ke liye wohi shabd rakho jo log type karte hain, discovery video ke liye curiosity ya stakes pehle rakho; poora caps ya clickbait mat rakho
why: Lamba title feed me kat jata hai; galat iraade wala title galat viewer lata hai jo turant chala jata hai
evidence_note: YouTube official title limit (100 chars) + creator title-mapping practice

name: Cover frame / title card
when: Short/Reel ka cover banate waqt
action: Cover par public-safe line ≤7 shabd me rakho (ExpoCut: frame 0 par padh sakne wala 3-5 shabd), center-anchored, ~2.0 s hold, 1-2 lines; Reels ke 1:1 center crop ke liye text x 22-78% ke andar rakho; cover frame video ke 0.3-0.4 s se render karo; test: cover dekh kar koi ajnabi topic bata sake
why: Cover hi grid me video ki pehchan hai — wahan se samajh na aaye to click bhi nahi aata
evidence_note: mktkit cover rules (public-safe gate) + ExpoCut frame-0 hook (Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com)

name: Shorts reframe subject par rakho
when: 16:9 footage ko vertical me badalte waqt
action: Crop ko shot-by-shot subject par rakho — fixed center crop kabhi nahi; do speakers hon to dono ko sikoṛne ke bajaye unke beech cut karo ya stack karo; screen ya wide shot ka relevant hissa bada karke dikhao; clips nikalne ka plan ho to 4K me record karo
why: Center crop aksar subject ko hi kaat deta hai; subject-centered reframing hi vertical ko asal lagta hai
evidence_note: kmilo shorts recipe ka creator practice

name: Style copy karna ho to pehle naapo
when: Kisi creator ki editing style copy karne se pehle
action: Pehle original ko naapo: cuts/sec (scene detection se), spectrogram se SFX aur hit ke pal, face screen ka kitna % hai, zoom jumps, music ki BPM aur voice ke neeche uski level — sirf frames dekh kar copy mat karo (wahan sound aur rhythm gayab rehte hain, aur copy isi liye nakli lagta hai); apne numbers original ke andar rakho (zyada jumps nahi, bada face nahi); result side-by-side compare karke hi dikhao
why: Do baar ki nakli copies (zyada zoom, bada face, har entrance par whoosh) isi sabak se bane rule hain — naap hi style ka asal DNA deti hai
evidence_note: Melvynx steal skill ke learnings (rejected copies ke aadhar par)
